behavior: A profile saves its billing details, and each new invoice keeps a copy of them
acceptance: R-43: PUT and GET /v1/profiles/{id}/billing-details save and return name, address, country, optional tax ID and contact email; another user gets 403; an invalid email or empty name gives 422
R-43: a test edits the details after creating an invoice and the invoice still returns the old copy; openapi.yaml and docs/backend/api.md describe the route
notes: 2026-10-10 review pass by reviewer: 00009 trigger keeps F084 numbering (same profiles UPDATE) and freezes all F084 fields plus issuer_*; Down restores 00008's function byte-for-byte, rollback test covers it. Issuer copied in the BEFORE INSERT trigger from one row, overriding any inserted values, so no partial or stale copy; replay reads the stored row. New table only has NOT NULLs, invoice issuer columns nullable: safe for existing rows. Country list matches tz iso3166.tab (249). Validation 422/400/401/404 shapes and both routes in the cross-user 403 list. openapi, api.md, architecture accurate. Backend tests pass on real Postgres. Minor, not blocking: whitespace-only name/address is accepted.

proof.1: backend: TestBillingDetails (PUT/GET round trip, replace, 404 before PUT; 422 for each missing or empty required field name/address/country/email, bad email, bad country, too long fields, NUL; 400 unknown field; 401), TestProfilesBelongToTheirUser (PUT and GET billing-details in profileRoutes: Bob 403)
proof.2: backend: TestInvoiceKeepsItsIssuerCopy (edit after create: public GET, list and idempotent replay keep the old issuer; profile without details gives issuer null), TestInvoiceNumbers (issuer columns frozen), TestMigrationsRollBackAndReapply; docs-check: apps/backend/api/openapi.yaml billing-details paths and Issuer schema, docs/backend/api.md Billing details section, docs/backend/architecture.md data model
